name: monday.com
summary: monday.com sells work management plans from $9 per seat a month on annual billing, with Standard at $12 and Pro at $19. Paid plans start at three users, and timeline and Gantt views begin on Standard. The free plan allows 2 seats and 3 boards.

facts.text: The free plan is limited to 2 seats, 3 boards and 3 docs.
The pricing page says plans start from 3 users, and plans for more than 40 users are quoted.
Timeline and Gantt views are included from the Standard plan, not on Basic or Free.
The pricing page mentions a 14-day free trial of the Pro plan.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Billed annually. Adds timeline and Gantt views

hiddenCosts: Paid plans start at three users, so a two-person team pays for three seats or uses the free plan.
The vendor says monthly billing is not discounted, and the pricing page lists annual prices.
